notes.title: Ian’s Eyes releasing today!
notes.notes:
Ian needs your help! Today you can take the role of his loyal guide dog North to get him to safety! The eerie atmosphere and challenging puzzles will keep you coming back to the game for hours. To celebrate the launch of Sindie Games’ debut title Ian’s Eyes, we are giving early buyers a launch discount of 10%! The full game will be available from 8PM GMT+1, don’t forget to wishlist the game to get a notification of the launch!

Hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Ian’s Eyes launches the first of September on Steam!
notes.notes:
[b]The horror called school just became much more … deadly. Blind boy Ian and his guide dog North are having an exceptionally stressful first school day. The day started with preparations for the school’s centenary, but now Ian and North are running for their lives! From September 1st you can help Ian escape his zombie classmates![/b]

After trying out the free [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/452340/]demo[/url], people can now almost get their hands on the full game! The 1st of September Ian’s Eyes will release in the Steam store being the debut title of developer Sindie Games, in collaboration with publisher SOEDESCO Publishing.

[b]About the game[/b]
Instead of bringing Ian to his classes, it’s now your job to lead him and yourself to safety after his schoolmates have turned into zombies… Their glowing eyes might look disturbing, but the zombies will only follow the sounds North and Ian make. It’s up to you to decide whether sound or silence will help you sneak past them. Sometimes North can go ahead and clear the way for Ian, but you can’t leave the poor boy alone for too long: He might panic and die!

[b]Features[/b][list]
[*]Guide Ian through the game as North, his faithful canine companion
[*]Use stealth, misdirection and guide to avoid the ghoulish students
[*]No violence
[/list]

notes.title: Ian’s Eyes – a game about a guide dog who has quite a terrible day at work…
notes.notes:
Trying to lead your owner through school becomes a huge and horrifying challenge when his schoolmates were turned into zombies! Sindie Games’ horror game will be released on Steam later this year, published by SOEDESCO Publishing.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25623859/0cc973ff1f5c9691c91f8b24699e84c5acd32e40.png[/img]

For a moment you might think you will be playing as Ian, a blind boy, attending a regular school. However, not everything is as it seems… The game does take place in a school, that much is true, but you will be playing as Ian’s guide dog, North, and you will be leading your owner through a school that is everything but normal.

Instead of bringing Ian to his classes, it’s now your job to lead him and yourself to safety after his schoolmates have turned into zombies… Their glowing eyes might look disturbing, but the zombies will only follow the sounds North and Ian make. It’s up to you to decide wether sound or silence will help you sneak past them. Sometimes North can go ahead and clear the way for Ian, but you can’t leave the poor boy alone for too long: He might panic and die!

Ian’s Eyes eerie artstyle and the Blue Norholm School’s dark, secluded hallways will surely give you the chills. This horror story can be experienced in Q3 2016 via Steam.
